events.title: Our first Playtest is now open! + GES 2026
events.summary: Hello everyone!You can now try THORNSPELL in our first playtest and share your feedback with us. It will run at least until June 30th, and we will use your feedback to polish the UI/UX of the game and make sure the experience is designed with fun as a priority.On top of that, we are also part of Game Effect Showcase 2026 alongside with a ton of other awesome games.Soon, more news, there's more exciting stuff cooking behind the scenes.Have fun!
